chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"The people of kindness in this world are the people of kindness in the Hereafter."

key_terms.أَهْلُ: people characterized by or belonging to a quality
key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the Hereafter, the life to come
key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفِ: kindness, goodness, and recognized virtuous conduct

ai.seo_question: How does kindness in this world benefit a person in the Hereafter?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that those who are known for doing good and showing kindness in the worldly life will likewise be among the people of goodness in the Hereafter. It highlights the enduring value of beneficence and its consequence beyond this world.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The people of kindness in this world are the people of kindness in the Hereafter."
